Scale-up/Scale-Down of existing services, request for new services listed in the Deliverables but not requested initially shall be done within 1 day of the request . The deliverables are indicative in nature and are the maximum projected requir ement of the CGWB. CGWB may or may not consume the entire requirement as specified in the Deliverables during the currency of the contract. Payment Terms and Conditions:- The billing cycle shall be Quarterly. Bill shall be furnished post consumption of services in the past billing cycle agai nst tax invoice along with consumption report of the past billing cycle, consump tion is to be based on a monthly basis. Consumption report is to be furnished as per the BOQ format. Tax Invoice is to be furnished as per the BOQ format. The Billing shall be on Pay-as-you-go basis wherein CGWB will pay the amount f or the services it has consumed in the billing cycle, pro-rate calculation to be do ne for service provisioned during the billing cycle. The Contract shall be valid for 5 years from the date of GeM Contract and is furt

her extendable up to 1 more year based on mutual consent of CGWB and the su pplier on same Terms and Conditions. The payment will be made through offline PFMS method. The payment will be re leased after submitting a certificate regarding satisfactory completion of the wo rk/services from the bill verification committee.
